description: This file provides IntelliSense support for Liquid templating language within the Monaco editor, including tag and filter definitions, context analysis, and language configuration.

methods.name: getLiquidContextInfo
methods.description: Analyzes the current cursor position in the model to determine if the context is within a Liquid tag or object, and whether to show filters or tags.

methods.name: ConfigureLiquidIntellisense
methods.description: Configures Monaco editor to provide Liquid language support, optionally including HTML suggestions.
